title: Binary to BCD Without Division

forbidden.message: no division or modulo: use shift-and-add-3 (double dabble)
no division, mod or rem: use shift-and-add-3 (double dabble)

constraints: `bcd = {hundreds, tens, ones}`, each a 4-bit BCD digit (0 – 9).
No `/`, `%`, `mod` or `rem` anywhere in the design: the judge rejects them.
Purely combinational and synthesizable. Loops are allowed.
hints: Double dabble: start with the BCD digits at 0 and shift the binary number in from the right, one bit at a time.
Before each shift, add 3 to every BCD digit that is 5 or more. After the shift it becomes ≥ 10 + carry, which is exactly the decimal carry.
8 input bits means 8 shift steps. A `for` loop over a 20-bit working register unrolls into a small adder network.
